# Files tools

Project settings, packaging the game as an app, running it in the real player, and the legal notices.

4 tools in the `files` category. Badges: **read-only** tools never change the project; **mutating** tools are undoable and attributed; **open-world** tools reach outside the engine and MCP clients ask before running them.

| Tool | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`game_settings`](#game_settings) | Read or change the project's shipping settings in game.json: startScene, window {width,height,fullscreen,resizable,vsync}, quality (low\|medium\|high\|ultra), renderScale, quitOnEscape, pauseOnFocusLoss, icon (a PNG, 1024x1024 recommended), bundleId (reverse-DNS), version, copyright, plus include/exclude globs for packaging, and the description fields (id, title, genre, mood, pitch), and mounts: shared folders outside the project addressed by a top-level name, e.g. |
| [`game_build`](#game_build) | Package the project as a standalone macOS app (Name.app): the player runtime, the scenes, the assets they reference (computed from scenes, prefabs, materials and Wander scripts; all_assets ships everything), scripts, the project's native module (compiled now), Info.plist, an icon made from the game.json icon, and an ad-hoc code signature. |
| [`game_run`](#game_run) | Start the standalone player on the current project as a separate process to try the game like a player would (real window, real input, audio). |
| [`legal_info`](#legal_info) | Skywalker's Terms of Use, Privacy Notice and license: their versions and effective dates, MCP resource URIs (skywalker://docs/legal/TERMS, skywalker://docs/legal/PRIVACY, skywalker://docs/LICENSING), whether a person has accepted the current versions on this computer (status current, outdated, not_recorded), and a verified summary of data practices (no telemetry; data leaves the computer only to the AI provider or download URL the human chose). |

### `game_settings` { #game_settings }

**Game settings (game.json)** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Read or change the project's shipping settings in game.json: startScene, window {width,height,fullscreen,resizable,vsync}, quality (low|medium|high|ultra), renderScale, quitOnEscape, pauseOnFocusLoss, icon (a PNG, 1024x1024 recommended), bundleId (reverse-DNS), version, copyright, plus include/exclude globs for packaging, and the description fields (id, title, genre, mood, pitch), and mounts: shared folders outside the project addressed by a top-level name, e.g. {"mounts": {"kit": "../_kit"}} makes kit/characters/guard.prefab.json resolve into ../_kit (assets, prefabs, materials and animations load from it; game_build copies what the game uses), and saves {version, maxSlots, compress, migrate} for save games (docs/SAVE_GAMES.md). `get` returns the effective settings, the resolved start scene and validation problems. `set` merges the given fields (null removes one) and validates them. Example: {"operation":"set","settings":{"title":"Sky Dash","startScene":"scenes/main.sky.json","window":{"width":1280,"height":720}}}

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | string |  | get (default) or set | `get` `set` |
| `settings` | object |  | Fields to merge into game.json (set only) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    game_settings {"operation": "set", "settings": {"title": "Sky Dash", "startScene": "scenes/main.sky.json", "window": {"width": 1280, "height": 720}}}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call game_settings '{"operation": "set", "settings": {"title": "Sky Dash", "startScene": "scenes/main.sky.json", "window": {"width": 1280, "height": 720}}}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "game_settings",
        "arguments": {
          "operation": "set",
          "settings": {
            "title": "Sky Dash",
            "startScene": "scenes/main.sky.json",
            "window": {
              "width": 1280,
              "height": 720
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `game_build` { #game_build }

**Build the game as a macOS app** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span> <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--open" title="Reaches outside the engine (network or other programs); clients ask the human first">open-world</span>

Package the project as a standalone macOS app (Name.app): the player runtime, the scenes, the assets they reference (computed from scenes, prefabs, materials and Wander scripts; all_assets ships everything), scripts, the project's native module (compiled now), Info.plist, an icon made from the game.json icon, and an ad-hoc code signature. Settings come from game.json (see game_settings). Returns the app path, size, file count by type, and warnings (missing assets, no icon). dry_run reports what would ship without writing anything. The app runs on this Mac; distributing it needs a Developer ID signature and notarization (docs/SHIPPING.md). Example: {"out":"/Users/me/Builds","release":true}

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `out` | string |  | Folder to write &lt;Name&gt;.app into (outside the project is best; ~/Desktop, ~/Builds) |  |
| `name` | string |  | App name (default: game.json title) |  |
| `icon` | string |  | PNG path (absolute or project-relative); overrides game.json icon |  |
| `version` | string |  | Game version like 1.2.0; overrides game.json |  |
| `bundle_id` | string |  | Reverse-DNS bundle identifier; overrides game.json |  |
| `scene` | string |  | Start scene override (project-relative) |  |
| `release` | boolean |  | Strip the player's symbols for a smaller app (default false) |  |
| `all_assets` | boolean |  | Ship every asset in the project, not only referenced ones (use when scripts build paths at run time) |  |
| `sign` | boolean |  | Ad-hoc code sign (default true) |  |
| `build_native` | boolean |  | Compile and ship native/*.cpp (default true) |  |
| `dry_run` | boolean |  | Only list what would ship |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    game_build {"out": "/Users/me/Builds", "release": true}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call game_build '{"out": "/Users/me/Builds", "release": true}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "game_build",
        "arguments": {
          "out": "/Users/me/Builds",
          "release": true
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `game_run` { #game_run }

**Run the game in the standalone player** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span> <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--open" title="Reaches outside the engine (network or other programs); clients ask the human first">open-world</span>

Start the standalone player on the current project as a separate process to try the game like a player would (real window, real input, audio). It runs the saved scene file (save first); without `scene` it uses the open scene or game.json's start scene. Returns the pid and a log file. `status` shows whether it is still running and its recent output; `stop` ends it. With `capture` the player renders one frame to a PNG after `frames` frames and exits (a screenshot of the real player output). `seconds` closes the game by itself. `app` runs a built .app instead. Example: {"action":"start","scene":"scenes/level2.sky.json","width":1280} or {"capture":"/tmp/shot.png","frames":120}

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string |  | start (default), stop, or status | `start` `stop` `status` |
| `scene` | string |  | Scene to start in (project-relative); default: the open scene |  |
| `app` | string |  | Run this built .app instead of the project |  |
| `pid` | integer |  | stop/status: which player (default: the latest) |  |
| `fullscreen` | boolean |  | Start fullscreen |  |
| `width` | integer |  | Window width in points |  |
| `height` | integer |  | Window height in points |  |
| `quality` | string |  | Quality preset override | `low` `medium` `high` `ultra` |
| `seconds` | number |  | Quit after this many seconds |  |
| `capture` | string |  | Write one frame to this PNG and quit |  |
| `frames` | integer |  | With capture: frames to run before the capture (default 90) |  |
| `wait` | boolean |  | Wait for the player to exit and return its output (default true with capture/seconds) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    game_run {"action": "start", "scene": "scenes/level2.sky.json", "width": 1280}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call game_run '{"action": "start", "scene": "scenes/level2.sky.json", "width": 1280}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "game_run",
        "arguments": {
          "action": "start",
          "scene": "scenes/level2.sky.json",
          "width": 1280
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `legal_info` { #legal_info }

**Legal documents and acceptance** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Skywalker's Terms of Use, Privacy Notice and license: their versions and effective dates, MCP resource URIs (skywalker://docs/legal/TERMS, skywalker://docs/legal/PRIVACY, skywalker://docs/LICENSING), whether a person has accepted the current versions on this computer (status current, outdated, not_recorded), and a verified summary of data practices (no telemetry; data leaves the computer only to the AI provider or download URL the human chose). Use it to answer licensing or privacy questions, or before advising on shipping. `document` (terms, privacy, license, licensing) adds that document's full text. Nothing waits for acceptance; a person accepts in the editor or with `skywalker legal --accept`, never an agent. Example: {"document": "privacy"}.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `document` | string |  | Include this document's full text: terms, privacy, license (the LICENSE file) or licensing (plain-language summary and third-party notices) | `terms` `privacy` `license` `licensing` |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    legal_info {"document": "privacy"}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call legal_info '{"document": "privacy"}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "legal_info",
        "arguments": {
          "document": "privacy"
        }
      }
    }
    ```
